notes: Revenue series = 'Total net revenues' (product + royalty) as reported, which EXCLUDES the one-time $45.0M patent litigation settlement Vicor booked in Q2'25 on a separate line ('Total net revenues and patent litigation settlement' was 141.0 in Q2'25). This is separable directly in the 10-Q/10-K (XBRL RevenueFromContractWithCustomer excludes it; 'Revenues' includes it). Q3'25 from Q3'25 10-Q (the FY25 10-K XBRL mis-tags 407.7 to Q3 dates; ignored); Q4'25 = FY25 407.701 - 9M 300.437 = 107.264; Q2'26 from Q2'26 10-Q. Caveat: Q2'26 royalty revenue jumped to $30.4M (Q1'26 ~$15.0M, Q2'25 $10.4M) 'due to a new license agreement entered into during the quarter' (10-Q); any catch-up/lump-sum portion is not separable from filings, so it is left in. Ex-royalty product revenue Q2'26 112.9 vs 85.7 (+31.8% YoY). No revenue guidance given; backlog $380M at 6/30/26. TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): OCF 84.4, capex 33.1 (incl. internal-use software), FCF 51.3 on revenue 474.0. Net cash = cash 453.6 + LT investment 2.5, no funded debt (leases excluded). Q1'26 OCF included a $28.6M litigation award payment by Vicor. GAAP op margin = 34.9/143.4. Founder Patrizio Vinciarelli controls 79.6% of votes. Vicor reports NO non-GAAP/adjusted EPS, so ttm_pe and eps_growth_ttm_pct use GAAP diluted EPS (its only EPS measure): TTM $3.12 (Q3'25 0.63 + Q4'25 1.01 + Q1'26 0.44 + Q2'26 1.04) vs prior TTM $1.46 (0.26 + 0.23 + 0.06 + 0.91). Distortions: TTM includes the $27.3M Q4'25 deferred-tax-asset benefit; prior TTM includes the $45.0M Q2'25 patent settlement. ttm_pe = $308.90 / $3.12 (SA GAAP trailing P/E 99.2x). market_cap_musd from SA $14.2B.
